target: Observable local movement relative to the scene; independent object motion requires separate evidence

real_data.uncertain_and_already_moving: Exclude from onset scoring, report counts
real_data.negative_scope: Fixed ROI over the entire clip; never assume an unannotated area is negative
real_data.matching: Proposal centre inside ROI; diagnostic only, not object recall or AP
real_data.abstention: Unknown output, never inactive; report coverage and censored starts
real_data.delay: Interval in event time, conditional on an observed response; also report all missed, early, truncated and unknown cases
real_data.aggregation: Per annotation and split; no pooling overlapping ROIs or multiple annotators
real_data.selection: Tune only on train; retain validation as evaluation, test_reserved untouched

controls.global_burst_note: Spatially widespread illumination-like event burst, no independently moving object. Deliberately tests a known confound.

requirements: Reviewed object identities and per-time geometry with observable/occluded states
Motion onset independent of first visibility and camera displacement
Predeclared spatial overlap criterion and one-to-one matching
Object-level recall with misses and abstentions in the denominator
Negative-scene alert exposure and scene/sequence-level uncertainty
